Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PII scope: anything that can directly identify a person (name, SSN, email, phone) plus free-text user inputs that can contain those values. For model prompts we treat raw inputs as sensitive.
- For troubleshooting we can accept masked/hashed inputs and aggregated traces; we cannot accept raw prompt storage beyond ephemeral processing.
- Procurement: Aaron is the owner here; he needs to see proposed SLA language and any operational controls (who can access logs, how access is audited).

Can Redwood confirm whether hosted API can guarantee zero retention for PII or whether that requires a Dedicated/Private deployment and customer-managed keys? Also, please include any options for a shortened operational log window (30 days preferred).

Elena
Director, Security & Privacy
FinSecure

Marissa / Rafael — forwarding Elena's clarifications. Notes from Security/product on options: 

- Hosted API: we do not persist raw customer prompts in long-term logs by default, but transient caching and operational traces may include prompt snippets for debugging. We cannot provide a contractual 0-retention guarantee for all hosted telemetry today.

- Dedicated (reserved) + customer-managed KMS: feasible to implement 0-retention for customer PII if we remove long-term logging of prompt content and only keep hashed/masked telemetry. This typically requires a Dedicated cluster or Private deployment and a brief integration window (~2-4 weeks) to adjust logging pipelines.

- Shortened logs: we can offer configurable log TTLs (30/60/90 days) for operational logs; access controls and audit logs are available (we record access events).

- Pilot suggestion: 30-day masked logs + restricted access for first 30 days, then revisit for longer retention if necessary. Security would also ask for a scoped SOC2 supplement and a runbook for incident debug without raw PII.

I'm attaching a quick options doc that lays out tradeoffs and the likely path forward for contract language.

If you want, I can draft the MAP and a proposed contract clause for 'PII non-retention' that legal can redline. Rafael — could you confirm any pricing delta for Dedicated pilot (temporary reserved pool) and estimate timeline?

Thanks — Camila

Thanks again for the clear requirements. Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed retention exception draft. High-level proposal: 

1) Pilot 
   - Scope: Dedicated pilot cluster for FinSecure with customer-managed KMS, masked logging for prompts, zero retention of raw PII in stored logs.
   - Duration: 30 days active pilot (start target: 8/3/2026).
   - Pricing: temporary Dedicated pilot discount applied; Rafael to confirm estimate (cc'd).

2) Operational controls

3) Contractual items

   - Redwood Product/Security (Camila/Neha): finalize technical design for masked logging and TTL config.

Please review and reply with any changes. If this looks OK, I’ll circulate the DocuSign link for signatures and Rafael will follow up with the pilot pricing estimate.
